parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal statute and no universal facility/document bans documented, but police have used bogus 'homosexuality' charges as a lever — a recent raid (May 2026) detained ~30 people, allegedly extorted them and charged them with a non-existent offence, showing the state acting as threat-framer toward gender/LGB-diverse people despite legality. Post-2024-election reporting documents 'unprecedented persecution' of LGBTQ people, and there is no hate-crime statute, no anti-discrimination law, no LGR route and no documented case of relief — recourse is essentially absent, so state-tolerated police abuse (tier 2) faces the traveller with thin protection. Weak rule-of-law backstop, political-crisis trajectory worsening, and mixed social attitudes (majority support equal rights but dated and contested). This resembles a state-tolerated-targeting profile with extortion, above pure social-friction cases but below universal-exposure/severe regimes: ~0.34.
